shouldFix.title: Ten current-standing clauses still speak as the frozen v5 predecessor instead of sarif leftover-join.v6.
shouldFix.subjectPattern: Each listed leaf puts `sarif leftover-join.v5` in the agent position of a present-tense candidate denial, including `does not apply v15`, `is not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle`, `does not advertise SARIF`, `does not resurrect it`, `does not record that table`, `does not execute fixtures`, and `does not discharge them`.
shouldFix.refutation: The prompt fixes the speaker as sarif leftover-join.v6. The subject separately freezes sarif leftover-join.v5 as an unmoved, unrecorded predecessor and says not to record it as current. A field-by-field comparison against frozen v5 shows all ten listed leaves are byte-identical to v5; they were valid self-statements in v5 and became stale predecessor-speaker statements when copied into v6. None is framed as predecessor history. The subject's genuinely historical v5 mentions are explicitly carried in authorityClaim, purpose, basedOn.predecessorV5, recordedInputs, remeasurementClause, doesNot, and findingDisposition; those are not part of this finding.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: The current basedOn roles and obligation reasons are the scoped explanations of what the candidate does and does not do. As written, those leaves prove restrictions only about the frozen predecessor, not about the v6 speaker whose obligation partition they support. A leaf lifted into a later recording would attribute the denial to the wrong artifact.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The statements remain true of frozen v5, and v6 restates the material no-apply, no-advertisement, no-G17, no-D9, no-RunId, no-execution, no-SATISFIED, and binds-NOTHING boundaries elsewhere with the correct speaker. No leftover bit, digest, current-occupancy claim, recording route, row status, or authority boundary changes. This is a systematic successor-attribution defect, not a semantic takeover.
shouldFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, retarget the present-tense speaker in the ten listed leaves to that successor's own fully stemmed artifact name. Preserve legitimate historical references to sarif leftover-join.v5, preserve sarif leftover-join.v4 as the D-182 current recorded remasurement until adoption, and preserve all remainder and non-authority fields.
